goal: Create a network scanning tool that performs comprehensive network scans, gathering information about devices and their connectivity.
acceptance_criteria: Script handles all specified parameters correctly (host, port, timeout, output)
Comprehensive error handling for socket operations
Detailed logging for debugging and progress tracking
Input validation for ports and hosts
Support for CIDR notation in host specification
JSON output format for easy parsing
All tests pass with proper socket handling and DNS resolution
Code properly exports functions from module level
